zh.title: 再现了著名的 NEOGEO 的每一个细节。关于“NEOGEO AES+”演示的报告，该产品可与过去的外设一起使用，并具有低延迟 HDMI 等现代功能 [TGS2026]
zh.summary: 将著名的《NEOGEO》带回现代的《NEOGEOAES+》在《东京游戏展 2026》上作为可玩产品展出。会场还举行了开发团队的发布会，介绍了该机的特点以及对NEOGEO复兴的承诺。

en.title: Reproduced the famous NEOGEO down to the last detail. Report on the presentation of "NEOGEO AES+" which can be used with past peripherals and has modern functions such as low-latency HDMI [TGS2026]
en.summary: ``NEOGEOAES+'', which brings back the famous ``NEOGEO'' to the modern era, was exhibited as a playable product at ``Tokyo Game Show 2026''. A presentation by the development team was also held at the venue, introducing the features of this machine and the commitment to the revival of NEOGEO.

items.title: 「水ダウ」の藤井健太郎氏が手がける「THE FIRST ZOMBIE」には，まだ明かせない“さまざまな仕掛け”が。制作チームに開発の裏側を聞いた［TGS2026］
items.summary: TGS2026のPhoenixxブースで，「THEFIRSTZOMBIE」Phoenixxの野崎雄大氏にインタビューを実施した。藤井健太郎氏がプロデュースする本作は，ゾンビになった主人公を操作し，人間をゾンビに変えて仲間を増やしていくゲームだ。企画が生まれた経緯や制作の進め方，ポップなキャラクター作りの裏側まで聞いた。

zh.title: 由“Mizu Dow”的藤井健太郎创造的“THE FIRST ZOMBIE”拥有目前还无法透露的“各种机制”。我们向制作组询问了开发的幕后细节【TGS2026】
zh.summary: 我们在 TGS2026 的 Phoenixx 展位采访了“THEFIRSTZOMBIE”Phoenixx 的野崎雄大先生。该游戏由藤井健太郎制作，是一款控制变成僵尸的主角，通过将人类变成僵尸来增加朋友数量的游戏。我们讨论了这个项目是如何产生的，制作是如何进行的，甚至是创作流行角色的幕后细节。

en.title: ``THE FIRST ZOMBIE'', created by Kentaro Fujii of ``Mizu Dow'', has ``various mechanisms'' that cannot be revealed yet. We asked the production team about the behind-the-scenes details of development [TGS2026]
en.summary: We interviewed Mr. Yudai Nozaki of "THEFIRSTZOMBIE" Phoenixx at the Phoenixx booth at TGS2026. Produced by Kentaro Fujii, this game is a game in which you control a protagonist who has become a zombie, and increases the number of friends by turning humans into zombies. We talked about how the project came about, how production progressed, and even the behind-the-scenes details of creating pop characters.
